title: Probing Fairness of Mobile Ocular Biometrics Methods Across Gender on VISOB 2.0 Dataset
benchmark_measurement: The paper does not measure anything related to faith or religion. It measures the fairness of ocular-based biometric user authentication and gender classification methods across males and females.
findings: The paper contains no findings related to religion.
